newsitem.title: NORWAY: NORDIC SKIING-YEGORAVA DISQUALIFIED FOR DOPING.
newsitem.headline: NORDIC SKIING-YEGORAVA DISQUALIFIED FOR DOPING.

text.p: Russian Lyubov Yegorova, who won Sunday's 5-km classic cross-country race in the Nordic skiing world championsips, tested positive for a banned substance, International Ski Federation (FIS) general secretary Gian Franco Kasper said on Wednesday.
She was disqualified and her gold medal will be awarded to Russian Yelena Vialbe, who came second, he added.
After she was told of the positive test, Yegorova, 30, six times an Olympic champion, admitted taking the drug Bromantan, a banned stimulant-cum-masking agent, Kasper said.
The fact she admitted taking the drug did not make it necessary to wait for the result of a second test on another sample before taking sanctions, he added.
Kasper said Yegorova was disqualified for all the races she had competed in at the world championships, which started last Friday, and would be barred from entering the upcoming races.
